features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1820: Medical-grade orthosis for patellar stabilization and lateral instability.
TUBULAR LATERAL BUTTRESS: Maintains patella alignment and prevents subluxation or dislocation.
ADJUSTABLE STRAPS: Enable customized compression for improved control and comfort.
BREATHABLE AIRMESH OPTION: Enhances ventilation to reduce heat buildup during activity.
LOW-PROFILE SLIM DESIGN: Lightweight construction for extended wear and mobility.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
